cases.name: Jo Ann Karales
cases.about:
She and her husband owned Connecticut-based Sea Lark Enterprises, a soap company and producer of  Soap Lift,   
biodegradable pads designed to help soap dry.
cases.narrative: On 10/02/2026, her body was found during a welfare check. He had shot her in the neck with a shotgun.
